faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: All essential information regarding ordering, delivery, and harvesting. For further questions, please contact us.
faq.s1: Choose your dish, add it to the shopping cart, and place the order online. You will receive an order confirmation alert
faq.s2: Standard orders are delivered within 30 minutes. Plus and Premium members receive priority delivery within 15 minutes.
faq.s3: We always strive to deliver fresh food prepared with high-quality ingredients. In the rare case of spoilage or leakage, we are happy to provide a refund.
faq.s4: Most of our meals are vegan. A small selection of non‑vegan options is also available, and all of them are prepared with the same focus on health and quality.
faq.s5: We focus mainly on vegan meals because they offer natural, balanced nutrition using organic ingredients. Our goal is to promote overall fitness and well-being rather than high-protein-heavy diets.
